# Osamah AlBahnasi

> Junior SAP Consultant · Software Engineer, based in Saudi Arabia. SAP-certified consultant and software engineer who's led delivery teams, shipped enterprise tooling, and is now taking that into ERP consulting.

Selected from 1,500+ global applicants (one of ~30 accepted) into SAP's Young Professionals Program (YPP), with SAP Certified Associate credentials in E2E Business Processes and Generative AI. Prior to SAP, three years as a software engineer at RFID Saudi Trading Company, where he took ownership of a cross-functional development team (UI/UX, PHP backend, Flutter mobile) as business analyst and delivery lead. Currently targeting a junior SAP consultant role (ERP / S/4HANA / BTP). Also exploring workflow automation, building with n8n to connect systems and automate processes end-to-end.

## Experience

- **SAP · SAP Digital Skills Center** — Young Professionals Program (YPP) Trainee, 04/2026–06/2026, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Selected from 1,500+ global applicants into SAP's flagship partner talent program; trained across SAP Business Suite, BTP, and Generative AI; earned SAP Certified Associate credentials in E2E Business Processes (IEE2E) and Generative AI Developer (C_AIG).
- **RFID Saudi Trading Company** — Software Engineer, 10/2022–09/2025, Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Took ownership of a cross-functional team (UI/UX, PHP backend, Flutter mobile) as business analyst and delivery lead; coordinated requirements and app releases with stakeholders; introduced structured documentation practices; performed SQL-based data cleaning; presented a department-wide IT status and strategic roadmap review to leadership.
- **National Talents Company** — Technology Coordinator Assistant, 07/2018–08/2018, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. Deployed and configured 800+ Raspberry Pi devices for national educational initiatives.

## Projects

- **3PL — Logistics & Warehouse Visualization Platform**: Delivery lead for a 4-person team (2 backend, 2 mobile). Shipped authentication, warehouse/storage CRUD, filtered reporting with Excel export, and inventory management. Also led AR/3D warehouse-navigation R&D (Unity, Blender, Immersal) from a standing start, scanning and modeling two physical facilities — shelved after hitting a real mobile-camera spatial-mapping hardware limit.
- **CarLog — Fleet Maintenance Tracking System**: Owned SRS documentation end-to-end across 4 revisions, coordinated a backend and a mobile developer, ran the phase 2 planning cycle. Shipped authentication, a notification system, exportable maintenance and accident records, and conditional equipment checklist logic.
- [Horse Racing Database System](https://github.com/OzyCode/ICS424_HorseRace): PostgreSQL analytical database with optimized queries, stored procedures, and triggers.
- [Uber Trip Analytics & ML Predictor](https://github.com/muzammilbehzad/Students-Projects-ICS474-Big-Data-Analytics-Fall-2024/tree/main/Project_s201970750_s201970370): Predictive models (Linear Regression, Random Forest) on trip patterns.
- [Blood Drive Management System](https://github.com/jawad-alalasi/ICS321): Web platform for managing blood donation drives, built with Agile practices.
- [This Portfolio](https://github.com/OzyCode/animations-demo): This site itself — built with Next.js and Motion for React, exploring scroll-driven reveals, gradient motion, and reduced-motion-aware interactions.
